findings.evidence: The definitions occur at Cone/Exact.lean:41,48 and Frobenius.lean:158. Searching their name prefixes finds only coneShortComplex_conflation, with no projection or splitting computation lemmas.
findings.fix: Add @[simp] projection lemmas identifying the short-complex objects/maps, presentation objects/maps, and splitting maps; remove @[expose] from both constructors.
findings.issue: coneShortComplex and coneIdentityInjectivePresentation (Frobenius.lean:157) use @[expose] without projection APIs; coneGradedSplitting also lacks formulas for its retraction and section. Consumers must unfold implementations to identify the advertised concrete maps.

findings.evidence: Lines 120–143 provide the functor comparison and @[simp] object/map computations; the unfolding proofs at lines 146,150,156 are local to this file and do not require downstream body exposure.
findings.fix: Remove @[expose]; retain the public comparison lemmas and instances as the consumer interface.
findings.issue: gradedSplitStableToHomotopy exposes its quotient-lift implementation despite already providing its characteristic comparison and object/map formulas.

summary: The concrete constructions lack characteristic projection lemmas, and three definitions unnecessarily expose their implementation bodies.
